When does New Year 2027 start in Ecuador?

Ecuador spans 2 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is Quito (UTC-05:00) at 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027, and the last is Galápagos Islands (UTC-06:00), 1 hour later.

The countdown above follows Quito, where midnight falls at 05:00 UTC.

Ecuador in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Quito follows 19 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 6 hours after Quito.

When the clock strikes midnight in Quito, 180 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-04:00): Bolivia, Brazil (Manaus), Canada (Halifax), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica and 6 more
  • Just after (UTC-06:00): Canada (Winnipeg), Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico (Mexico City), Nicaragua, United States (Chicago) and 1 more

Who celebrates at the same time as Ecuador?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-05:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Quito: Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Mexico (Cancún), Panama, Peru, United States (New York), Bahamas, Haiti and Jamaica.

New Year traditions in Ecuador

At midnight, Ecuadorians burn "años viejos", effigies made of paper and sawdust that represent the year that is ending. Earlier in the day, men dressed as "widows" playfully ask passers-by for coins.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Ecuador in UTC?

Midnight in Quito corresponds to 05:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027. Other regions of Ecuador follow, up to 1 hour apart.

How many time zones does Ecuador have on New Year's Eve?

Ecuador uses 2 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC-05:00 in Quito to UTC-06:00 in Galápagos Islands.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Ecuador on New Year's Eve?

No. Quito keeps UTC-05:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Ecuador?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-04:00, which includes Bolivia, Brazil (Manaus), Canada (Halifax), Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica and 6 more.
